test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only 2 people sit to the left of E. G is an immediate neighbour of E. B sits to the immediate right of F. Only 3 people sit between G and F. A sits to the immediate left of D.

Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north,

1) Only 2 people sit to the left of E.

2) G is an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/918019f850b0d3634f1394952f46c3509c3be6925fc082d8c3dec44bc30d7781.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7148401ab836aa9692aff41e2697f781dff6960e741f63dc4c3a23d1de068a3b.png] 

3) Only 3 people sit between G and F → This Eliminates Case 1(Because, There is no possible position left for F)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bbff31552d6ab7663d27202482fe1828148d62281c0c3e10898d68a734822da.png] 

4) B sits to the immediate right of F.

5) A sits to the immediate left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5a08d6335f0359a34710f3a451378826667322a19fbbdb2e86678b6ede62a1b.png] 

So, C will sit at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)". **
